info.title: Beans News API & MCP
info.description:
Beans finds and verifies what publishers published. It returns citable Articles, Source metadata, attention-ranked feeds, similar publisher reading, external Article mentions, and normalized filter discovery.

Choose by intent: search Articles with /beans/articles/search; monitor recent publication with /beans/articles/latest; monitor fixed headlines with /beans/articles/top-headlines; monitor attention with /beans/articles/trending; retrieve one known Article with /beans/articles/{id}; find related reading with /beans/articles/{id}/similar; inspect external observations with /beans/articles/{id}/mentions; resolve publisher metadata with /beans/sources.

Collections return {pagination, meta, data}; empty collections return HTTP 200 with data: []. Follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor. limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100. No offset or page aliases are accepted. from and to use inclusive UTC calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD. JSON is canonical. Use Espresso for structured Events, Signals, impact, forecasts, or evidence relationships.

Bean.title: Bean
Bean.description: One publisher Article. id is canonical identity and url is a citable public attribute. Use Espresso for structured Events and Signals.

url.description: URL is the canonical URL of the article or post.

content_type.description: Public content_type accepts every stored type listed in the Beans contract. Omit the filter to include all stored types.

title.description: Title is the human-readable headline or title of the content.

summary.description: Summary is a short abstract or teaser used in listings and previews.

content.description: Content is the full body text when the source content is available.

author.description: Author is the byline or attributed creator when available from the source.

source.description: Nested Source metadata identified by Source UUID.

image_url.description: ImageUrl is the featured image or preview image associated with the content.

published_at.description: Created is the original publish timestamp of the article or post.

categories.description: Categories lists the inferred topics assigned to the content.

regions.description: Regions lists geographic regions mentioned in or associated with the content.

entities.description: Entities lists named entities such as people, places, organizations, or products.

tags.description: Computed tags merged from categories/regions/entities for display

sentiments.description: Sentiments lists inferred tones or sentiments expressed in the content.

BeanTrend.description: Article plus nullable observed attention metrics. Missing metrics remain null or absent; zero is not fabricated.

Answers: Which normalized Article filter values can I use?

Returns: A cursor-paginated collection of extracted labels.

Use when: a value spelling is unknown before Article filtering.

Do not use when: a known normalized value is already available; query Articles directly.

Search/filter behavior: q matches discovery values case-insensitively.

Time: No time filter applies.

Sort/pagination: Follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: The collection may be empty; labels are not canonical entities, coordinates, taxonomies, or confidence scores.

Next step: Carry a returned value into the corresponding Article filter.

Provider parallel: Provider catalogs such as Currents available filters are comparable discovery aids; Beans exposes direct plural resources.

Answers: Which Articles are attracting attention in the fixed recent window?

Returns: A cursor-paginated collection from the most recent 24-hour window, ordered by attention.

Use when: a breaking-news or daily-headline feed is needed without a custom time range.

Do not use when: historical bounds, archive search, or a 7-day trend window is needed; use search, latest, or trending.

Search/filter behavior: Article filters and q with optional score_threshold are accepted; ids and urls belong to search.

Time: The service applies a fixed recent 24-hour creation and attention window; from and to are not accepted.

Sort/pagination: Attention-ranked; follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: summary, content, enrichment, Source metadata, and trend metrics may be absent or null.

Next step: Use /articles/{id} for citable detail.

Provider parallel: GNews and NewsAPI.org top-headlines and TheNewsAPI headlines are comparable feeds; Beans retains UUID Article records.

Answers: What publisher Articles were published most recently?

Returns: A cursor-paginated collection ordered by published_at descending.

Use when: a recent monitoring feed is needed and publication recency matters more than archive relevance.

Do not use when: semantic archive search, headlines, or attention ranking is needed; use search, top-headlines, or trending.

Search/filter behavior: q with optional score_threshold and shared Article filters; include values are OR within a field and fields combine with AND.

Time: from and to are inclusive UTC publication dates in YYYY-MM-DD; omitted from defaults to the most recent 7 days.

Sort/pagination: Newest first; follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: Article enrichment, Source metadata, summary, and content may be null or omitted.

Next step: Use /articles/{id} for detail.

Provider parallel: NewsData.io latest and Currents latest-news are comparable recent feeds; Beans returns normalized Article UUIDs and cursor pagination.

Answers: Which Articles are receiving the most observed attention?

Returns: A cursor-paginated attention-ranked Article collection with nullable trend metrics.

Use when: what is gaining attention matters more than publication recency.

Do not use when: chronological monitoring or the fixed headline window is needed; use latest or top-headlines.

Search/filter behavior: q with optional score_threshold and shared Article filters narrow candidates before attention ordering.

Time: from and to are inclusive UTC dates for observed trend activity; omitted from defaults to the most recent 7 days.

Sort/pagination: Attention-ranked; follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: trend and each metric may be absent or null; zero is not fabricated.

Next step: Use /articles/{id} or /articles/{id}/similar.

Provider parallel: World News top-news and TheNewsAPI top-news are comparable attention feeds; Beans makes nullable metrics explicit.

Answers: Which publisher Articles match this query?

Returns: A cursor-paginated collection of UUID-identified publisher Articles.

Use when: broad retrieval, semantic search, exact IDs or URLs, or combined filters are needed.

Do not use when: newest, headline, or attention-ranked results are needed; use the dedicated feed route.

Search/filter behavior: q is semantic; score_threshold requires q; ids and urls are exact; include values are OR within a field; fields combine with AND; full_content changes projection only.

Time: from and to are inclusive UTC publication dates in YYYY-MM-DD.

Sort/pagination: Follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100; offset and page are unsupported.

Missing fields: Article enrichment, Source metadata, content, story_id, and trend may be null or omitted.

Next step: Use /articles/{id}, then links.similar or links.mentions.

Provider parallel: World News /search-news, GNews /search, NewsAPI.ai getArticles, NewsAPI.org /everything, and Currents /search are comparable broad-search routes; Beans adds Article and Source UUIDs.

Answers: Which publisher Sources match this metadata query?

Returns: A cursor-paginated collection of UUID-identified Source records, not Articles.

Use when: Source metadata or a Source UUID for Article filtering is needed.

Do not use when: Article content or publication search is needed; use /articles/search or a feed.

Search/filter behavior: q matches Source domain, name, and URL case-insensitively; domains are exact.

Time: No time filter applies.

Sort/pagination: Follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: name, description, favicon_url, and rss_feed_url may be null.

Next step: Use /sources/{id} or carry the UUID into Article sources filters.

Provider parallel: NewsAPI.org /sources and Perigon or TheNewsAPI source catalogs are comparable discovery routes.

post.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for the Beans service. Exposes Beans tools to MCP-compatible clients such as AI agents and LLM-powered applications.

get.description:
Answers: What did this specific publisher Article say?

Returns: One Article detail record inside data, identified by UUID, with links for similar Articles and external mentions.

Use when: an Article UUID is already known and citable metadata or optional full content is needed.

Do not use when: the UUID is unknown; use search or a feed first.

Search/filter behavior: the path UUID is exact; full_content=true requests the available body without changing identity.

Time: published_at is the publisher timestamp; no time window applies.

Sort/pagination: One detail record; no cursor.

Missing fields: title, summary, author, image, Source metadata, story_id, and content may be null or omitted.

Next step: Follow links.similar or links.mentions.

Provider parallel: TheNewsAPI UUID lookup, World News retrieve-news, and NewsAPI.ai getArticle are comparable known-Article routes.

Answers: Which other publisher Articles are useful related reading?

Returns: A cursor-paginated similarity-ranked collection for the anchor Article; it is not a guarantee of Story membership.

Use when: comparable coverage or related context is needed for a selected Article.

Do not use when: all durable Story members or external mentions are needed.

Search/filter behavior: the path UUID is the anchor; Source, domain, author, label, type, and date filters narrow candidates; q, score_threshold, ids, and urls are unsupported.

Time: from and to are inclusive UTC publication dates in YYYY-MM-DD.

Sort/pagination: Similarity-ranked; follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: Article enrichment, Source metadata, and content may be null or omitted.

Next step: Use /articles/{id} on a selected result.

Provider parallel: TheNewsAPI similar-by-UUID is the closest reviewed provider route; Beans states that similar is not Story membership.

Answers: Where was this Article URL observed externally?

Returns: A cursor-paginated collection of social or forum mention observations; a mention is not another publisher Article.

Use when: external attention or discussion is needed for a known Article.

Do not use when: publisher republication coverage or related reading is needed.

Search/filter behavior: the path UUID is exact; platforms and forums are optional metadata filters.

Time: from and to are inclusive UTC observation dates in YYYY-MM-DD.

Sort/pagination: Observed-time order; follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: forum and engagement metrics may be null; empty results are HTTP 200 with data: [].

Next step: Use /articles/{id} or /articles/trending.

Provider parallel: External mention tracking is a Beans extension and is not equivalent to publisher Article coverage.

Answers: What publisher metadata belongs to this Source UUID?

Returns: One Source detail record inside data.

Use when: a citation needs publisher metadata.

Do not use when: Articles from the Source are needed; use /articles/search with sources.

Search/filter behavior: the path UUID is exact; no collection filters apply.

Time: No time filter applies.

Sort/pagination: One detail record; no cursor.

Missing fields: name, description, favicon_url, and rss_feed_url may be null.

Next step: Use the Source UUID in Article search.

Provider parallel: Most provider Source detail routes are domain keyed; Beans makes Source UUID canonical.

Answers: Which categorical sentiment labels can I use as Article filters?

Returns: A cursor-paginated collection of sentiment labels.

Use when: the sentiment spelling is unknown before Article filtering.

Do not use when: a known label is already available; query Articles directly.

Search/filter behavior: q matches discovery values case-insensitively; labels are categorical, not numeric confidence scores.

Time: No time filter applies.

Sort/pagination: Follow pagination.next_cursor unchanged as cursor; limit defaults to 20 and maxes at 100.

Missing fields: The collection may be empty; no numeric sentiment score is returned.

Next step: Carry the value into the sentiments Article filter.

Provider parallel: Provider sentiment fields are usually Article attributes; Beans exposes accepted labels for agent discovery.
